cohort: Women aged 11-59 years undergoing peripartum hysterectomy due to obstetric hemorrhage within 7 days of delivery in six Italian regions
finding: The peripartum hysterectomy prevalence in Italy was 1.09 per 1000 maternities, three times higher than in the UK, the Netherlands, and Nordic countries, with previous cesarean section, assisted reproductive technology, multiple pregnancy, and maternal age ≥35 years being the main associated factors.
